About this item

  • 【Mechanical Keyboard: Responsive BLue Switches】RisoPhy PC keyboard features clicky keys which offer you higher accuracy and quicker response with an enjoyable click sound when typing.This keyboard is more comfortable to type on since it features deeper key travel,greater feedback,and more space between keys.For those who prefer keyboards with a more tactile and "clicky" feel,our keyboard with BLUE switches is a nice choice.
  • 【Rainbow Backlit Keyboard: illuminate Your Desktop】With 9 different backlights,5 levels of light speed and brightness,this computer keyboard enriches your gaming experience and improves your mood greatly,which is a great addition to your desktop,especially in the dark.Plus,the ultra-durable double injection ABS engineered keycaps provide crystal clear uniform backlight and greatly improve your typing accuracy at night.
  • 【High-end 104 Keys Full-Size Keyboard】The Win lock function frees your worry about mistyping when gaming(Fn+Win).Keycaps are pluggable and easy to clean,saving you much unnecessary trouble.We designed 4 hydrophobic holes for this keyboard,allowing water to flow away quickly to prevent damage to the keyboard.No longer afraid of accidents.(✦Include a keycaps puller for cleaning or other needs.)
  • 【Advanced Ergonomic Comfort】This PC gamer Keyboard adopts a scientific stair-up keycap design that keeps your arms in the most natural state to minimize hand fatigue for long time use.In order to improve your posture and make you more comfortable during use,the wired keyboard comes with 2 strong foldable rear kickstands to slope it.Moreover,the keyboard is non-slip enough because there are 4 rubber padding underneath the keyboard.
  • 【100% Anti-Ghosting & 12 Multimedia Combinations】100% anti-ghosting gaming keyboard allows all keys to work simultaneously,no matter how fast you type.12 multimedia key shortcuts allow you to quickly access to calculator/media/volume control/email.RisoPhy mechanical gaming keyboard with the number pad greatly improves your productivity.This ultra-durable keyboard with up to 50 million keystrokes life works well with Windows 7/8/10/XP/VISTA/95/98/XP/2000/ME/VISTA and Mac OS Xbox etc.

Mechanical Gaming Keyboard

  1. 104 Keys Full-size Mechanical Gaming Keyboard

  1. No Afraid of Accidents

Anti-Wear UV Letters

The never-fade keycaps are precisely manufactured to provide uniform light transmission and offer high recognition for color and letters in the dark.

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

    • zeroryouko
      5 out of 5 stars
      Great mechanical keyboard for productivity
      Reviewed in the United States on June 29, 2023
      Color: Classic Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Bought this keyboard for my office, as a replacement for a wireless, membrane based keyboard that was starting to show its age.

      The value of this keyboard is excellent. Based on the feel, it seems to be a true mechanical keyboard with switches, and not a simulated one using a membrane contact with a clicky mechanism. The feel is great and the pressure is just right to prevent most accidental touches to adjacent keys from inserting extra letters. Nice and clicky, maybe not the best for noise if you're in an office with other people, but the feel is great and if you work in a private office like I do the noise won't matter much. I had thought the RGB colors would be distracting, especially for an office, but actually they are fairly subdued and actually seem to help with positioning (I am a fast hunt-and-peck 3 finger typist, so this actually matters a lot to me).

      I have a much more expensive Razer mechanical gaming keyboard at home, and the main difference I see between them, other than cosmetic differences, is that the Razer keys seem like they have a hair trigger and require very little motion to produce keystrokes, while this keyboard is a bit stiffer and requires the keys to be depressed a little harder in order to produce a keystroke. So if you are relying on a hair trigger response for gaming, this maybe is not the best choice, although for a casual gamer like me it's more than adequate. But for actually getting work done, the hair-trigger of the Razer keyboard makes it really hard not to make typos, and this keyboard is a lot better in that regard.

      One minor nitpick is that the font used to label the keys is a little odd, and the "6" really, really looks like a "G", which can be a little off-putting at first. But that's just a minor quibble.

      Final verdict: Definitely worth buying, unless you're an absolutely elite hardcore gamer.

      I got this keyboard for a couple of reasons. I type at night, and when I wake up early, I'll do schoolwork. It's backlit and I can see the keys in the dark. There are a few settings to have the keys act or light up differently. And, because I have medium-long nails - the keys are large enough, and there is enough space between them, to accommodate my medium-length gel nails. I got raised keycaps to stick on the keys of this keyboard but they are not necessary for the length of my nails. Its appearance is as depicted, not too big, not too small. The keyboard connected easily to my laptop and is just as easy to set on top when not in use. It unplugs from the USB outlet easily, making removability a cinch when I decide enough is enough (not often) and pack everything up and put it away. It's very responsive, typing exactly as I type or game. None of the keys have stopped working or gotten stuck, even with my long nails. I love the sound of the keys clicking, again not too loud nor too soft. It gives me a 90s vibe while typing, and I can hear if I've hit the keys. Overall, I'm very glad I decided to buy this keyboard. It's perfect for my needs.

      Reviewed in the United States on May 29, 2026

      If you're looking for a slim, low profile, led mechanical keyboard with blue switches, then you will be happy with this. The keyboad is exactly as described in the listing. The keyboard housing is made of plastic which makes the keyboard lightweight. The keys have a nice tactile feel with a nice "clicky" sound. The build quality is good, but doesn't compare to the solid feel of my Motospeed or Red Dragon keyboards. Included with the keyboard is a little plastic keycap puller.

      The led's are nice and bright and can be turned off. The CON is that each key is a set color, so if you're looking for a keyboard whose keys can change to various colors, you might want to skp this one. I personally did not care for any of the available 9 light modes. The 9 modes were definitely not exciting in my opinion and with keys being a preset color, I found some of the modes quite distracting. You can increase, decrease the brightness or turn off the leds. If you're looking for a keyboard where each key can display a multitude of different colors, this is keyboard is not for you.

      As for the the sole purpose of using this as a mechanical keyboard, then you won't be disappointed. I purchased this for use at work because I love the tactile feedback of mechanical keyboards. I didn't not test the liquid resistance of the kayboard but there are cutouts on the bottom for liquid drainage. No key ghosting was detected during its use. Again, if LED keyboards is what you fancy, I don't think you will be pleased with this because the keys are a preset color and can't be changed. As for the function of being a mechnical keyboard, this works well for the price point.

    • Eddie Risbergs
      5 out of 5 stars
      Feels like the legendary Model M, sporting it strong points and its quirks.
      Reviewed in the United States on May 27, 2025
      Color: Classic Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      If you missed the old,clicky Model M from IBM, this keyboard emulates it pretty well. One must consider though, that it may emulate it too well. If you have fat fingers, you will find yourself making the same typos that you mad in high school when you learned to type on one. However, this is no deal breaker in my opinion. The speed at which I can type has vastly improved with the solid tactile feedback that tells you without a doubt that you press was registered.

      Setup couldn't be easier, just plug it into any USB port and away you go. Recognizes immediately as a 104 key with perks. Having the media controls and other immediate functions right there is nice too.

      As far as the design goes, it is very rugged and ready for the millions of keystrokes you will put on it as a writer. You will find a kind of typing joy you haven't experienced in quite a long time. No soft-touch or sickle keyboard will match the feel from what you get here.

      The only thing I find really off is the shallow height of the back stands. I think that they should be redesigned to be a bit taller. I cut a little piece of flat trim to set them on and that made the angle perfect.

      All-in-all, this keyboard is a joy to type on. I don't use it for gaming, because I see this as a waste of a premium feeling keyboard, wearing out the ASWD area and ruining it. I haven't had such a good keyboard in years and I'm not destroying that way.

      The one caveat I would warn you about is that if you use it on a KVM switch that is USB powered, this keyboard draws quite a bit of power to run the back light. be aware that you may get video background issues. Mine works just fine if I turn the backlight down low.

    • Kelly Potvin
      5 out of 5 stars
      High Quality, Gorgeous LED Backlighting, Perfect Price
      Reviewed in Canada on December 10, 2022
      Color: Classic Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This mechanical keyboard is amazing for gamers looking to pick up a high-quality blue-switch mechanical keyboard. When I consider and review this product, I keep the following factors in mind:

      Functionality and Use - 5/5

      The overall functionality of this keyboard is perfect, leaving me with minimal complains as a high-frequency and intensity user. As a proficient typist, I frequently type over 120 WPM and use combinations of hotkeys to complete tasks efficiently. This keyboard has supported this level of use during work/office settings, and feels highly responsive and crisp during high-intensity gaming moments, due to the blue key-switches creating a noticeable "click" with each keypress. If you have roommates or family, you may want to consider the clicking sounds of this keyboard while typing. The fact that they will likely hear your typing due to the pure "clicky-ness" of the key switches may present itself as an issue to some. Personally, this is not a factor that applies to my circumstances.

      Build Quality and Durability - 5/5

      After 1 Month of intensive use, I have not noticed any issues so far in terms of key-press responsiveness, structural integrity, or wiring/USB issues. The keys hold in place well and the LED's have stayed consistently bright.

      Product Design - 5/5

      The design of this keyboard is minimal, but effective. Exactly what I was looking for when shopping for a keyboard within this general price range. The all-black style allows the LED backlights to really *pop*, even in bright light/daylight. The inclusion of a "Fn" key allows for the same hotkeys and macros most would be used to with other keyboards, such as volume control and media playback, amongst other things.

      QoL Features - 4.5/5

      This keyboard comes with 9 different LED-backlighting effects, such as lighting per keypress, "breathing" effects, WASD + Arrow Key backlighting, and more to complement a variety of use-cases. It would be nice to have the option to customize the LED backlighting colours themselves, as the backlighting options are pre-set; however, the crisp glow and colour choice are visually appealing and I am happy with the options provided.

      Value for Money - 5/5

      Overall, I am highly satisfied with the purchase of this Keyboard and would recommend it to any gamer, office-worker, or avid tech geek like myself. For such a low price-point, you are getting a physical product that is equal in quality to that of a name brand like Razer or Corsair, without paying for the related bloatware and branding. Anybody looking to pick up their first mechanical keyboard, you cannot go wrong with this!

    • Mr Knyvett
      5 out of 5 stars
      Good quality, affordable mechanical keyboard. Surprised by its quality given its price range.
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on June 1, 2026
      Color: Classic Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Very satisfied with this purchase. Head and shoulders above my membrane Logitech K120 Wired Business Keyboard, and without breaking the bank too! To be honest, I feel lucky to have gotten this keyboard at such a low price. At this price point, I could not find a single mechanical keyboard that met all of my requirements but this one. In fact, even some of the more expensive mechanical keyboards didn't meet all of my requirements. For starters, the keyboard uses the UK layout with the pound sign and hash symbol key in the right place—very important for me. Second, this is a full-size keyboard with a numeric keypad at the right. This was important for me as I wanted a keyboard that did all of the same things as my previous keyboard, the only difference being that it is mechanical—a requirement that this RisoPhy mechanical keyboard fulfils precisely. (I should note, too, that most of the mechanical keyboards at this price range and even some more expensive ones, being shorter in width, lacked a numeric keypad.) Then there is the feel of the keyboard. The product description says that it uses "BLUE switches", seemingly modelling its switches on the classic tactile and clicky Cherry MX Blue switches. (It is unlikely that the keyboard uses actual Cherry MX Blue switches, given the price range, but rather its own knock-off versions of the switches.) While this may not be what some gamers are looking for (looking for something smoother and offering the same resistance all the way down without a slight bump as you press each key), this is perfect for me, as I was looking for a keyboard that produced nice responsive, tactile feedback, mirroring a classic typewriter effect. Some people may be put off by this, thinking that it makes the keyboard too noisy, and while, yes, there is a clicking noise with each key press, it honestly isn't that loud (though because there is still an audible clicking noise, I can understand criticisms saying that this keyboard is inappropriate for an office environment, for example, where such a constant clicking noise can cause distractions.) The keyboard is nice to type on, which is my primary use for it rather than gaming.

      A feature I don't care as much for is the rainbow backlighting. From my tests, the "9 different backlights" settings mentioned in the product description work exactly as expected. Also working as intended (at least from my tests on Windows 11) are the "12 multimedia combinations", effectively function keys that perform operations, such as, open a calculator and open Windows search.

      The major downside to this keyboard that I can think of is that the keyboard switches are not hot-swappable (though at this price point, this isn't a disappointment but just something to be expected.)

      In all, if you are looking for a keyboard that meets some of the same requirements as I was, at this price, I am unaware of a better keyboard on this website than this one.

    • Prudence
      5 out of 5 stars
      Parfait pour les frappes rapides
      Reviewed in France on June 11, 2024
      Color: Classic Black
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Comme dit dans un autre commentaire, il est parfait quand c'est ce qu'on veut. J'écris énormément et j'ai une frappe très rapide.

      Quand on frappe vite, le top c'est un clavier mécanique de ce type, et c'est très rare d'en trouver à moins de 100€!

      [FRAPPE]

      J'ai une préférence pour ceux avec un retour son (comme sont les claviers à switch/commutateur bleu) et bon un anti-ghosting: on peut frapper vite, avec exactitude et si besoin corriger dans l'immédiat. Que ce soit pour du gaming ou de la frappe écrite très rapide, c'est un excellent clavier.

      Par contre, clairement, je ne vois pas des personnes qui tapent occasionnellement supporter ce clavier, qui est bruyant... comme un clavier à commutateur bleu! Quand je suis au téléphone, j'essaie parfois de taper un truc discrètement: je me fais griller systématiquement et on me dit de ne pas fracasser mon clavier... les gens sont habitués à des claviers silencieux.

      [SOLIDITÉ]

      Le clavier est vraiment excellent: je l'utilise depuis 1 an, de manière intensive. La touche espace est un peu usée (lustrée mais on voit toujours la barre horizontale) mais toutes les touches sont encore parfaitement lisibles, ce qui est exceptionnel pour de l'ABS et mon utilisation intensive! Des heures de frappe par jour, au moins un nettoyage par semaine (pas délicat, avec un produit, et des brosses pour enlever les masses de poils de chats... et les miettes ^^ ).

      [ERGONOMIE]

      La surélévation est un peu trop marquée pour moi: elle créé une casse du poignet qui fatigue, mais le retour tactile est énorme.

      Comme dit, le rétroéclairage est à un dosage parfait: ni trop peu (aide au repère rapide en cas de besoin), ni trop (fatigue des yeux).

      Les pattes arrières qui ont tendance à se replier, mais je suis une grosse brute et ça me gêne moins que sur de nombreux claviers.

      [CONCLUSION] Clavier adapté à une personne qui cherche du matériel solide, efficace, de bonne qualité à petit prix et surtout un clavier mécanique avec un retour son marqué. Pour moi on n'est pas loin du clavier parfait!
